summary: Full backend + frontend test pass for YONII. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases pass (root/health, chat moderation ALLOW+REDIRECT, symptom-check, mock payments order/verify, image-check 402/409/415 gating + happy path + delete, admin JWT login, stats, recent-chats/payments, KB CRUD, auth-required checks). A dedicated vision probe confirmed GPT-4o really receives the uploaded image (described a blue circle correctly). Frontend: age gate (confirm/reject/localStorage persistence), homepage (7 prompt pills, 6 hub cards, Rs9 CTA, footer), example-prompt auto-send chat, follow-up chat, all 6 hub routes, 4 legal pages, symptom checker, full Rs9 image-check mock-pay flow + delete, admin login/protected route/stats/recent lists/KB add+delete/logout, mobile hamburger nav and no horizontal overflow. Two real defects found: chat has no multi-turn memory, and AI markdown '#'/'##' headings render literally.

critical.issue: Conversation context is NOT preserved. Re-posting with the same session_id returns 'I need a bit more context / could you let me know what specific concern' for a follow-up like 'Is it common in men over 40?'. LlmChat is constructed fresh per request and no prior turns are replayed, so every message is treated as turn 1. Reproduced by /app/backend/tests/test_chat_context.py (fails).

minor.issue: Unauthenticated and returns {ok:true} even for a non-existent/never-owned id (no 404). Any client that learns an analysis_id can delete records; should return 404 when delete_one matched 0.
Returns ok:true for unknown ids; no 404 on 0 matched documents.
allow_origins='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is an invalid CORS combination (browsers reject credentialed wildcard). Set explicit origins or drop allow_credentials.
Deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks; migrate to lifespan. Also the admin seed never re-hashes if ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env is later changed.

Raw user questions (highly sensitive sexual-health text, 1000 chars) are persisted in db.chats and exposed verbatim in /api/admin/recent-chats, which conflicts with the UI's 'No account - No history' privacy promise. Consider hashing/truncating or storing only the moderation verdict.

ui_bugs.issue: Markdown ATX headings are not parsed - users see literal '# Educational Guidance: ...' and '## What to Avoid' in chat, symptom-checker and image-check output. Only '**bold**' lines are converted to headings. Add handling for lines starting with #, ##, ### (and '**Heading**:' with trailing colon, which also renders as plain paragraph).

integration_issues.issue: UI correctly sends session_id but backend has no memory, so follow-up answers ask the user to restate context - looks broken to the user.

issues: Children are still mounted (blurred) behind the gate, so the Home page and its network work run before age confirmation - render null/placeholder instead.
'I'm under 18' is a dead end: no way to go back to the 18+ choice without a reload.
Hero content is confined to the left ~45% with a large empty band on the right; consider a right-side visual or wider max-width.
Severity uses the browser-native <select> ('Choose...') while the rest of the app is custom-styled; inconsistent with the shadcn/ui look.

For a flat/uninformative photo GPT-4o sometimes replies 'I'm unable to view or analyze images' even though the image was received (verified separately) - paid users get a non-answer. Consider prompt hardening / a low-information-image guard, or refund messaging.

action_items: Fix multi-turn chat memory in POST /api/chat (replay prior turns for the session_id, e.g. from db.chats, or keep a per-session LlmChat history).
Fix AIMessage.jsx to render '#'/'##'/'###' markdown headings instead of printing the hash characters.
Return 404 from DELETE /api/image-check/{id} and DELETE /api/admin/knowledge/{id} when nothing was deleted.
AgeGate: do not mount/blur the app behind the gate; add a way back from the 'under 18' state.
Reconsider storing raw chat questions verbatim given the 'no history' privacy promise.
critical_code_review_comments: claude_chat() creates a new LlmChat per request with only a system message - session_id is cosmetic, so conversational continuity is impossible by construction.
delete_analysis() has no auth or existence check; combined with the always-200 response it silently succeeds on invalid ids.
Deprecated FastAPI on_event startup/shutdown hooks should be replaced with a lifespan context manager.
moderate() fails open to ALLOW on any LLM error - acceptable for availability, but it means a moderation outage disables BLOCK/REDIRECT protection entirely; add alerting/metric on moderation failure.

success_rate.backend: 96% (23/24 incl. context probe; only multi-turn context fails)
success_rate.frontend: 92% (all flows work; markdown heading rendering + chat continuity defects)

seed_data_creation: Mock Razorpay orders/verifications and a few TEST_ prefixed KB entries + image analyses (KB entries deleted after test; image analyses deleted via API where created by the flow test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (23 pass). test_chat_context.py currently FAILS by design - it is the multi-turn memory bug; re-run after the fix. test_vision_probe.py proves image reaches gpt-4o (use a shape/colored image, NOT a flat color, or the model replies it cannot see images). Frontend: set localStorage yonii_age_confirmed_v1='yes' to bypass the age gate; the image-check file input is display:hidden so use wait_for_selector(state='attached') + set_input_files; mobile nav links use testids suffixed '-mobile' (e.g. nav-sti-mobile).
rca_of_the_issue: Multi-turn failure: POST /api/chat instantiates emergentintegrations LlmChat per request with only MEDICAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT and the current user message; no prior turns are supplied, so the model has zero history despite a stable session_id being round-tripped. Markdown bug: AIMessage.jsx only recognises lines matching ^\*\*text\*\*$ as headings and treats every other line as a paragraph, so Claude/GPT ATX headings ('# ', '## ') are printed verbatim.
